findings.message: An empty catch block hides the failure: handle it, or say in a comment why it is safe to ignore.
findings.instead: Catch only what you can handle, say why in a comment when you ignore an error on purpose, and let the rest fail loudly. Guard the real boundaries: user input, the network, files.

findings.evidence: if (!loan.member) throw new Error('Something went wrong');
findings.message: "Something went wrong" names no cause: give a stable code and say what failed and what to do.
findings.instead: Give each failure a stable code and a plain message that says what failed and what to do next.

findings.message: var mixed with let and const: match the file.
findings.instead: Match the surrounding file and the project's formatter, even where you prefer another style.

findings.message: A 5-line doc comment on a one-line function, mostly repeating its name.
findings.instead: Keep a docstring when it says something the signature cannot: units, side effects, errors, a surprising rule.

findings.message: getLoans() only passes its arguments to loadLoans(): call loadLoans() directly.
findings.instead: Call the real thing directly. Add a layer when a second use or a real seam needs it.

findings.message: "data" says nothing about what it holds or does.

findings.message: "Boolean(!!" converts a value to the type it already has.
